anomalies.description: Two individuals are actively firing assault rifles; muzzle flash and smoke are visible from the weapons.
A large explosion occurs inside a building, shattering windows outward and producing smoke and debris; figures are seen reacting inside the room.
Two individuals are actively firing handguns in an industrial yard; muzzle flash and smoke are visible from the firearms.

A person in dark clothing is seen aiming and firing a handgun from behind a concrete pillar; muzzle flash and smoke are visible in the background, indicating active gunfire.; A person in dark clothing takes cover behind a pillar and fires a handgun; visible muzzle flash and smoke confirm discharge.; Sparks and bright flashes inside the building indicate ongoing gunfire or weapon discharge, with a figure moving away from the source.
A man in a brown jacket is shown mid-air, lunging or being thrown over a large green dumpster in an alleyway, suggesting physical combat or evasion during a struggle.
A man in a tan jacket is on the ground near vehicle debris, then rises while appearing to engage or react to an off-screen opponent; his posture and motion suggest ongoing physical confrontation.
A woman aims and fires a handgun; visible muzzle flash and recoil at 33.0s confirm discharge.
Two individuals fire long guns (likely assault rifles) in an indoor setting; muzzle flash and weapon positioning indicate active shooting.

A person in dark clothing is seen kneeling over a prone, unconscious individual on the ground and appears to be checking or restraining them; the prone person shows signs of injury (blood on face) and is unresponsive, indicating abuse of a helpless victim.

A person in a black ribbed jacket is seen leaning over and physically interacting with a prone, seemingly unconscious or injured man lying on the ground; the interaction includes placing hands on his chest/neck area and appears non-consensual and harmful, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.

A man lies on his back, visibly injured with blood on his mouth and face, while another figure looms over him in a dark setting; the man's expression and posture suggest he is helpless and being attacked or has just been assaulted.

The man’s head is thrown back with mouth open (f2–f3), consistent with impact or struggle; the presence of a looming figure and the rapid transition to the woman’s distressed reaction suggests an ongoing physical confrontation ending around this time.

The woman shows a startled, fearful expression with wide eyes and slightly open mouth, suggesting she is witnessing or reacting to an ongoing abusive act nearby; however, no direct perpetrator or victim is visible in these frames alone, so confidence is moderate.
A woman is shown aiming a handgun directly at the camera with both hands, in a clear shooting stance; the gun is held steady and pointed forward, indicating an imminent or ongoing act of shooting.
A motorcycle collides with a parked black sports car; the rider is thrown forward upon impact, visible as the bike hits the car’s side in f10 and the rider begins to fall in f11.

After the crash, a person lies motionless on the ground next to the fallen motorcycle while another individual (partially visible in f9–f10) appears to approach or interact aggressively; by f11–f12 the victim remains prone and unresponsive, suggesting ongoing abuse of a helpless person.
After the crash, the fallen rider is engaged in physical struggle on the ground with another person near the motorcycle; motion blur and body positions in f12–f15 suggest grappling or striking.
